description.text:
Looking for a unique and fun filled time out? Make Clays Canary Wharf your target! 

Clays offers a high-tech interactive clay target shooting experience bringing the best of the British countryside to the heart of the city. Guests can enjoy thrilling interactive games on huge high-def screens set in a sleek and modern interior complete with a spectacular bar, private room, expansive heated outdoor terraces, and even a treehouse-style DJ booth.

The menus at Clays have been carefully curated by culinary director Roger Olsson, formerly of The Dorchester, The Ritz, and Pierre De Terre, offering delicious sharing plates alongside must-try signature cocktails so that you can refresh and reload in style.

Clays Canary Wharf is the perfect destination for time out with friends, colleagues, or larger parties and events. Guests can book the private area for corporate events, birthdays, hens and stags, or team-building socials. With the only digitised clay target shooting experience in London, a premium food and drink offering, and striking spaces, Clays promises an unforgettable experience for all.
